ground.result: Makin organized resistance ends during the afternoon centered; Tarawa hardening is not copied onto Makin because trained combat manpower remains the dominant ceiling.
ground.effect_on_air: Three-CVE-class support remains sufficient through the decisive ground period. Release/reallocation toward Tarawa begins only after closeout and cannot retroactively help Tarawa morning fighting.

I175.old_result: Pierce APA-50 torpedo hit / I-175 heavily damaged
I175.reason: The 26/27 Japanese surface raid has shifted to Tarawa, so the Makin screen is not locally disrupted by that raid; the regional alert after the Tarawa surface attack also keeps ASW/screen discipline high during Makin reorganization.
I175.centered_event: I-175 obtains a marginal/longer-range firing opportunity during reorganization but scores no confirmed hit; counter-ASW causes light-to-moderate damage/fatigue and forces a temporary separation from the closest approach, but not a campaign-ending damage state.
I175.sensitivity: A single APA/AKA/LST torpedo hit remains plausible but is no longer the most-likely integer outcome. USS Pierce is therefore reopened/not damaged by default in this working line.

submarine_system_note: Prolonged Tarawa shipping dwell still creates additional submarine opportunity on 28 Nov and later; no compensating automatic high-value hit is booked.
